notes: «قالوا حدثنا سفيان» : three co-narrators in one level
the three Companions «قالوا كنا عند رسول الله» tell the scene and the Prophet's judgment: they are the last level
«قال هشام فغدا عليها» at the end continues the narrative after the saying: not a link in the chain
«فقال خصمه» and the man who asks God are scene, not links
